original:
ॐ नमो भगवते तस्मै यत एतच्चिदात्मकम् ।
पुरुषायादिबीजाय परेशायाभिधीमहि ॥
sanskrit:
ॐ नमो भगवते तस्मै यत एतच्चिदात्मकम् ।
पुरुषायादिबीजाय परेशायाभिधीमहि ॥
transliteration:
oṃ namo bhagavate tasmai yata etac cid-ātmakam |
puruṣāyādi-bījāya pareśāyābhidhīmahi ||
translation: Gajendra prayed: O Lord, who is the embodiment of consciousness and the primeval seed of all existence, the supreme controller, I offer my surrender unto You.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: गजेंद्र ने स्तुति की: जो चेतनामय परम पुरुष और समस्त जगत के मूल कारण हैं, उन परमेश्वर को मैं बारंबार नमस्कार करता हूँ।

layers.author: sant_eknath
layers.content: गजेंद्राने प्रार्थना केली: जे चैतन्यमय परम पुरुष आणि या विश्वाचे मूळ कारण आहेत, त्या परमेश्वराला मी शरण जातो.

layers.author: sridhara_swami
layers.content: Gajendra Stuti in Canto 8 is revered as the ultimate prayer of absolute surrender when all personal strength and worldly allies fail.

layers.author: prabhupada
layers.content: The elephant king remembered his prayers from his previous life as King Indradyumna, proving that spiritual consciousness carries across births.
